scoring_justification: Headline quantities are DFT total energies and derived transition levels that cannot be recomputed from raw wavefunction or structure files in the lightweight verifier; scoring compares agent‑reported numbers against paper‑reported gold with tolerances and trend requirements.

hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct quote from the paper’s result for Ga_Sn^0 off‑center relaxation.

outputs.description: Energy difference between off-center and on-center neutral Ga_Sn configurations in bulk SnO2 (eV). Compared to the paper-reported reference with tolerance for method-dependent spread.
Defect transition level ε(0/−) for Ga_Sn in bulk SnO2 (eV above VBM). Compared to the paper-reported reference with tolerance.
Defect transition level ε(0/−) for Ga_Sn under 6.22% volume compression (eV above VBM). Compared to the paper-reported reference with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the submitted values to the paper-reported quantitative results using appropriate tolerances that account for expected variations due to different implementations of HSE and pseudopotentials. The exact tolerances are part of the hidden grading specification.
